mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.tool_operation o WHERE o.space_id=#{space} AND o.task_id=#{task} AND o.id=#{id}
SELECT id,space_id,task_id,call_id,NULL::text call_json,call_hash,status,NULL::text result_json,NULL::text result_hash FROM pf.tool_operation WHERE space_id=#{space} AND task_id=#{task} AND id=#{id}

SELECT FROM pf.tool_approval_binding a JOIN pf.task_interaction i ON i.id=a.interaction_id WHERE a.space_id=#{space} AND a.task_id=#{task} AND a.call_id=#{call} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.interaction_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM pf.tool_approval_binding a JOIN pf.task_interaction i ON i.id=a.interaction_id WHERE a.interaction_id=#{id}

SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'actor',actor_id,'space',space_id,'state',state,'version',version,'projectId',project_id)::text FROM pf.workspace WHERE id=#{p.workspaceId} AND space_id=#{p.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{p.actorId}
SELECT count(*) FROM pf.tool_approval_binding a JOIN pf.tool_operation o ON o.id=a.operation_id WHERE a.space_id=#{space} AND a.task_id=#{task} AND a.fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND o.status='DENIED'
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.tool_operation o SET status='DENIED',result_json=#{result}::jsonb,result_hash=#{hash},ended_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE o.id=#{operation} AND o.space_id=#{lease.spaceId} AND o.task_id=#{lease.taskId} AND o.status='PREPARED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.operation_execution_binding b WHERE b.operation_id=o.id AND b.attempt_id=#{lease.attemptId} AND b.fencing_token=#{lease.fence})
